rationale: Positives: The agent verified identity via full name + ZIP, located the correct account and order, correctly identified the pending status, obtained a reason for cancellation, and when removal wasn’t supported, successfully exchanged the air purifier for the cheapest available variant with correct pricing and refund amount. Negatives (fail conditions): 1) The agent performed an order-changing write (exchanging to item 9534205511) without first stating the exact change (specific model/price and refund method) and obtaining explicit confirmation, as required by policy. 2) The user wanted the refund to a gift card; the account had a gift card on file, and the modify API accepts a payment_method_id. The agent chose the credit card instead, contrary to the user’s request, and only afterward stated they couldn’t change the refund destination. These breaches mean the request was not completed fully in line with policy despite correct execution of the exchange itself.
